senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; Parel of <cite ref="U00103"><he>שבט</he></cite> , v. <cite ref="U00104"><he>שֵׁבֶט</he></cite>)

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 2:5">Snh. II, 5</cite> <he>ואין משתמשין בשַׁרְבִיטוֹ</he> and we dare not use his (the king’s) sceptre.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:16">Cant. R. to II, 16</cite> <he>אין שרביטו</he> … <he>שלבם וכ׳</he> God’s rod (of chastisement) comes down only upon men whose heart is soft like lilies; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:5">Ukts. I, 5</cite> <he>ש׳ של תמרה שריקנו</he> a twig of a date tree which was stripped of its dates.
<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:5">Ib.</cite> <he>וכן בקטניות ש׳ שריקנו</he> and so in the case of summer fruits, if they emptied the pods on a stem.
